chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
And the Umrah is once every year.
ai.seo_question: How often should one perform Umrah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted via the reliable chain of Hammad ibn al-Halabi, establishes the baseline recommendation for performing Umrah once annually. Within the context of *Al-Istibsar*, this ruling serves as the foundation for the broader chapter title, which elaborates that the permissibility extends to performing it every ten days, highlighting the flexibility and high merit of this pilgrimage in Shia jurisprudence.
